# Restack

> Enterprise-scale AI agent platform for designing, testing, and optimizing intelligent workflows with Kubernetes orchestration and Temporal-based automation.

Restack provides an open-source stack and managed cloud platform for product and engineering teams to build production-ready AI agents. The platform supports multi-cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, Azure) with Python and TypeScript SDKs, integrated observability, and pre-built connectors for popular business tools.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Agent Design & Testing
- Kubernetes Scaling
- Temporal Workflow Orchestration
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Workflow Automation
- Enterprise Platform
- Product Intelligence
- Customer Support Automation
- Sales Intelligence
- Performance Marketing
- Observability
- Multi-Cloud Deployment
- Python & TypeScript SDKs
- Prompt Management

## Solutions by Role

- [For Product Teams](https://www.restack.io/product-teams): Design, test and optimize agents at Enterprise Scale with A/B testing and observability
- [For Engineering Teams](https://www.restack.io/engineering-teams): Build Agents and MCPs to scale to millions with Python/TypeScript SDKs and Kubernetes
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.restack.io/enterprise): Enterprise AI agent solutions with Kubernetes and Temporal workflow orchestration

## Use Cases

- [Customer Support Agents](https://www.restack.io/usecases/customer-support): AI customer support agents with Zendesk and Intercom integrations
- [Sales Intelligence Agents](https://www.restack.io/usecases/sales-intelligence): Sales intelligence agents with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Slack integration
- [Product Intelligence Agents](https://www.restack.io/usecases/product-intelligence): Product intelligence agents with Amplitude and Statsig integrations
